# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.

Report vulnerabilities in upstream components through their respective
security processes:

- [Trusted Firmware-A security handling](https://trustedfirmware-a.readthedocs.io/en/latest/process/security.html)
- [U-Boot security handling](https://github.com/u-boot/u-boot/blob/master/doc/develop/security.rst)

For vulnerabilities affecting this repository's build scripts, CI workflows,
packaging, release artifacts, provenance, or bundled rkbin firmware, use
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/dbast/qnap-ts-433-bootloader-builder/security/advisories/new).

If ownership is unclear, report the vulnerability privately here. It will be
routed to the appropriate upstream project when necessary.

## Supported versions

Only the latest release is supported with security updates.
